user.title: Translink Queensland
user.description: Track a journey, create a departure board or monitor regional service notices.

data_description.mode: Choose Journey for a trip, Stop / Station to search by name or number, Nearby stop to search around a location, or Service Notices for GTFS-RT alerts.

journey.title: Configure Journey
journey.description: Choose a starting point, destination, and live feed region.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this commute (e.g. Daily Commute).
data_description.start_name: Station, bus stop, ferry wharf, or address (e.g. Central station).
data_description.end_name: Destination station, stop, or address (e.g. Springfield Central station).
data_description.transport_modes: Select public transport modes to include in routing.
data_description.realtime_region: Cairns and South East Queensland have public live feeds. Choose schedule only for other regions.
data_description.track_vehicle: Create a live GPS device tracker for the active transit vehicle.

stop.title: Configure Stop Departure Board
stop.description: Enter a station or bus stop name to track live upcoming departures.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this departure board (e.g. Roma Street Station).
data_description.stop_name: Stop name or station (e.g. Roma Street station).
data_description.transport_modes: Modes to monitor from this stop.

journey_select.title: Choose journey locations
journey_select.description: Several locations match your search from {start_query} to {end_query}. Choose a location for each field shown.

data_description.start_location_id: Select the starting point for this journey.
data_description.end_location_id: Select the destination for this journey.

stop_select.title: Choose a stop or station
stop_select.description: Several stops or stations match {stop_query}. Choose the one you want to track.

data_description.stop_location_id: Select the stop or station for this departure board.

nearby.title: Find nearby stops
nearby.description: Choose a Home Assistant zone or a map point. Home Assistant sends the selected coordinates to Translink once per lookup and discards them after the lookup.

menu_options.nearby_point: Choose a point on the map

nearby_zone.title: Choose a zone
nearby_zone.description: Find stops near the centre of the selected zone.

nearby_point.title: Choose a map point
nearby_point.description: Move the marker to the location you want to search.

nearby_select.title: Choose a nearby stop
nearby_select.description: Confirm the exact stop ID for this departure board.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Translink
reconfigure.description: Update location and transport settings for this Translink entry.

data_description.realtime_region: Cairns and South East Queensland have public live feeds. Choose schedule only for other regions.

notices.title: Configure service notices
notices.description: Choose a Translink network and scope for service notices.

data_description.notice_route_id: For route scope, enter a GTFS route ID such as RPSP. Passenger-facing route names and numbers may differ.
data_description.notice_route_mode: For transport mode scope, choose the mode to monitor.

notices_reconfigure.title: Reconfigure service notices
notices_reconfigure.description: Update the name, network or scope for this service notice entry.

data_description.notice_route_id: For route scope, enter a GTFS route ID such as RPSP. Passenger-facing route names and numbers may differ.
data_description.notice_route_mode: For transport mode scope, choose the mode to monitor.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Translink API
error.location_not_found: Could not find any matching stop or station in Translink network
error.no_board_location: No stop or station matched. Enter a stop or station name, or a stop number.
error.invalid_location_selection: Choose a location from the search results.
error.region_mismatch: Choose a live feed region that serves this journey, or choose schedule only.
error.location_unavailable: Choose a zone or map point with valid coordinates.
error.no_nearby_stops: Translink found no nearby stops for this location.
error.invalid_route_id: Enter a printable GTFS route ID of 1 to 128 characters.

abort.already_configured: This Translink journey, stop or notice scope is already configured
abort.reconfigure_failed: Reconfiguration failed because the config entry could not be found

init.title: Translink Options
init.description: Customize polling frequency, walking preferences, and fare types.

data_description.scan_interval: How frequently to refresh realtime timetables and GPS feeds.
data_description.time_search_mode: Whether to plan journeys leaving after current time or arriving before.
data_description.fare_preference: Preferred go card fare category to display.
data_description.track_vehicle: Expose live GPS vehicle positions on Home Assistant maps.

data_description.scan_interval: How frequently to refresh the regional Alerts feed.

plan_journey.name: Plan a journey
plan_journey.description: Find scheduled alternatives for a configured Translink journey at a selected Brisbane date and time.

entity_id.name: Itinerary sensor
entity_id.description: The itinerary sensor of the journey to plan.

time_search_mode.name: Time preference
time_search_mode.description: Choose whether the journey should leave after or arrive before the selected time.

sort_by.name: Sort by
sort_by.description: Sort alternatives by scheduled departure, scheduled arrival, or duration.

limit.name: Maximum alternatives
limit.description: The maximum number of alternatives to return.

planner_entity.message: Select a registered Translink itinerary sensor.

planner_itinerary.message: The selected entity must be a Translink itinerary sensor.

planner_entry.message: The selected sensor is missing a Translink configuration entry.

planner_unloaded.message: The selected Translink journey is unavailable. Check that the integration entry is loaded.

planner_journey_mode.message: Select an itinerary sensor from an entry configured in Journey mode.

planner_upstream.message: Translink could not plan the journey. Check the selected date and time and try again.
